title: Treasury December coupon announcement — sizes and CUSIPs for the 3-Year, 10-Year (R) and 30-Year (R) block that prices around the 12-09 FOMC
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes, PDF CreationDate 2026-08-04), FlateDecode streams inflated PER PAGE and rows rebuilt from Tm coordinates. Three page-3 rows carry the identical announcement date `Thursday, December 03, 2026`: `3-Year NOTE` (auction 12-07, settle 12-15, no `R`), `10-Year NOTE / R` (auction 12-08, settle 12-15) and `30-Year BOND / R` (auction 12-10, settle 12-15). 11:00am ET is Treasury's standing coupon-announcement convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-3y-note-2026-12-07 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09), reading the same schedule PDF that dates that event. Filed because it is that event's OWN CONFIRMING PRIMARY and nothing tracks it: the calendar carries eight treasury-coupon-announcement-* entries between 2026-09-03 and 2026-11-19 as first-class entries, and then stops — there is no December one, canonical or proposed, so no sibling sweep is positioned to find it. WHAT IT SETTLES, and the reason it is worth a ledger rather than a line: this is the document that flips treasury-3y-note-2026-12-07 from `estimate` to `confirmed` and publishes the one number nobody can know before it (the CUSIP — the 3-Year is a NEW ISSUE every month, `reopening: "No"` on every row in the series, so unlike the 10-Year and 30-Year reopenings beside it, its CUSIP does not exist until this morning). WHAT IT DOES NOT SETTLE: the size. A quarterly refunding statement SETS coupon sizes and an ordinary monthly announcement only PUBLISHES them, so the December sizes were decided at the 2026-11-04 quarterly refunding (already tracked as `treasury-refunding-2026-11-04`), 33 days before the auction. Expect $58B/$42B/$25B — the 3-Year leg would be the 33rd consecutive $58B new issue since 2024-04-09, 30 of them completed through 2026-09-08 with zero deviations. STRUCTURAL NOTE: this announcement is a Thursday, not the Wednesday a refunding statement uses, which is itself the tell that December is a mid-quarter block. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
